caustica.options.rt.exposureMode.tooltip: How the ray-traced image is mapped to display brightness. Auto adapts to scene luminance; Manual uses the exposure value directly.
caustica.options.rt.manualEv.tooltip: Exposure compensation in stops. In Manual, this is the fixed exposure. In Auto, this biases the auto exposure brighter or darker.
caustica.options.rt.spp.tooltip: Adds lighting and reflection path samples after the first hit; the primary ray and motion guides still use one sample. It can reduce lighting noise but not temporal ghosting, and costs more GPU time.
caustica.options.rt.maxBounces.tooltip: Maximum number of secondary path-tracing bounces after the primary hit. Higher captures more indirect light but costs more.
caustica.options.rt.sunSize.tooltip: Angular radius of the sun and moon disk. Larger discs cast softer shadow penumbrae.
caustica.options.rt.entities.tooltip: Include entities and block entities in the ray-traced scene.
caustica.options.rt.particles.tooltip: Draw particles as camera-ray billboards inside the traced scene.
caustica.options.rt.glow.tooltip: Draw the vanilla Glowing-effect outline (through walls) around glowing entities.
caustica.options.rt.parallax.tooltip: Adds surface depth to solid blocks using resource-pack height maps. Requires LabPBR normal textures with height in alpha. Does not change block outlines; fades at distance and grazing angles.
caustica.options.rt.parallaxDepth.toolti: Controls height-map depth. 0% disables displacement; 100% uses the resource-pack depth; 200% doubles it. Only affects solid opaque terrain.
caustica.options.rt.depthOfField.tooltip: Blur the world in front of or behind the focus plane. Choose crosshair autofocus or distant miniature focus. UI stays sharp. Off by default.
caustica.options.rt.depthOfFieldMode.too: Autofocus follows the crosshair. Distant miniature fixes focus farther away so foreground and background blur visibly.
caustica.options.rt.depthOfFieldFocusDis: Used in Distant Miniature mode. Toggle zoom on, then Shift-scroll to adjust the focus plane in game.
caustica.options.rt.depthOfFieldStrength: Adjust out-of-focus blur radius. 0% disables blur; 100% is the default strength; 200% is stronger.
Controls samples per blurred pixel. Higher settings smooth the blur and reduce edge noise at a greater GPU cost; focus distance stays the same.
caustica.options.rt.depthOfFieldForegrou: Extra samples for spreading out-of-focus near surfaces beyond their silhouettes. Higher is smoother; each sample reads one depth texel, so the higher tiers stay cheap. Blur strength is unchanged.
caustica.options.rt.zoomFactor.tooltip: Press Zoom (C by default) to toggle, then press it again to return to normal view. Scroll for magnification or Shift-scroll for distant focus. The Zoom key is rebindable.
caustica.options.rt.waterWaves.tooltip: Animate water-surface normals for moving wave highlights.
caustica.options.rt.waterWaveStrength.to: Controls twelve-layer surface/reflection waves, bounded low-frequency eight-layer refraction, and twelve-layer physical caustics. 0% uses geometric normals and neutral caustics; 100% is default; 200% doubles amplitude.
caustica.options.rt.waterFog.tooltip: Add depth haze and geometry-occluded sun or moon shafts while viewing through water. Water absorption remains active when disabled.
caustica.options.rt.waterFogStrength.too: Controls underwater emerald/cyan haze and Tyndall shafts without changing direct water visibility.
caustica.options.rt.waterTransparency.to: Controls direct underwater visibility. 0% is most opaque, 100% is the recommended balance, and 200% is clearest.
caustica.options.rt.airFog.tooltip: Add natural height-dependent distance haze to air segments.
caustica.options.rt.airFogStrength.toolt: Scale atmospheric fog density from clear air to dense haze.
caustica.options.rt.volumetricLight.tool: Add terrain-occluded sun and moon shafts in air.
caustica.options.rt.volumetricAbsorption: Controls air and underwater shaft attenuation. 0% makes shafts brighter and longer; 100% keeps the previous look; 200% fades them faster. Fog strength and water clarity stay separate.
caustica.options.rt.planarClouds.tooltip: Enable analytic cloud planes and per-surface shadows. Off hides clouds.
caustica.options.rt.cloudQuality.tooltip: Low: coverage only, no extra probes; Medium: edge detail and two sun/sky probes each; High: more detail and three or four probes each.
caustica.options.rt.cloudLayers.tooltip: One low cloud sheet, or add a higher, thinner cirrus sheet.
caustica.options.rt.cloudSamples.tooltip: Preserves the 8–64 sample-budget setting. At High detail, 48+ raises sun and sky probes from three to four each. No view-ray marching.
caustica.options.rt.cloudCoverage.toolti: Scales cloud coverage while rain and thunder continue to increase low clouds.
caustica.options.rt.cloudDensity.tooltip: Controls cloud opacity and sun occlusion. 0% is transparent.
caustica.options.rt.cloudSpeed.tooltip: Controls the drift of low and high clouds without changing rain or water ripple speed.
caustica.options.rt.hdr.tooltip: Present in HDR (ST.2084/PQ) instead of SDR, when the display supports it. Takes effect after restarting the game.
caustica.options.rt.hdrPaperWhite.toolti: Absolute brightness (in nits) that SDR-equivalent scene brightness maps to on an HDR display.
caustica.options.rt.hdrPeak.tooltip: Absolute brightness (in nits) highlights roll off toward. Set to your display's peak HDR brightness.
caustica.options.rt.dlssRr.tooltip: Off shows the undenoised ray trace at native resolution. It can be noisy and slower, but helps compare motion ghosting. Switching rebuilds render resources.
caustica.options.rt.frameGeneration.tool: Inserts generated frames between rendered frames. Turn it off temporarily to inspect real frames during motion.
caustica.options.rt.dlssQuality.tooltip: DLSS Ray Reconstruction quality mode. Lower-quality modes render fewer pixels and upscale more aggressively for higher framerates; higher-quality modes render more pixels for a sharper image. Only affects the image when DLSS Ray Reconstruction is enabled.
caustica.options.rt.debugView.tooltip: Visualize an intermediate ray-tracing buffer instead of the final image.
